name: JAC Japan map 15 km (historical): Hojo human opens the official diplomacy screen with Takeda and reads the '1534 feud' relationship reason

steps.code: local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName(),'^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; if id.HOJO==nil or id.TAKEDA==nil then error('Hojo or Takeda missing') end; if Game.GetLocalPlayer()~=id.HOJO then error('local player is not Hojo: '..tostring(Game.GetLocalPlayer())) end; local function feud(a,b) local n=0; local mods=Players[a]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticModifiers(b); if mods then for _,t in ipairs(mods) do if t.Score==-10 then n=n+t.Score end end end return n end; if feud(id.TAKEDA,id.HOJO)~=-10 then error('Takeda->Hojo feud penalty '..feud(id.TAKEDA,id.HOJO)) end; if feud(id.HOJO,id.TAKEDA)~=-10 then error('Hojo->Takeda feud penalty '..feud(id.HOJO,id.TAKEDA)) end; return 'Hojo human: Takeda<->Hojo carry the -10 feud score'
if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then OnClose() end; return ContextPtr:IsHidden()

local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName(),'^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; if id.HOJO==nil or id.TAKEDA==nil then error('Hojo or Takeda missing') end; if Game.GetLocalPlayer()~=id.HOJO then error('local player is not Hojo: '..tostring(Game.GetLocalPlayer())) end; local function feud(a,b) local n=0; local mods=Players[a]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticModifiers(b); if mods then for _,t in ipairs(mods) do if t.Score==-10 then n=n+t.Score end end end return n end; if feud(id.TAKEDA,id.HOJO)~=-10 then error('Takeda->Hojo feud penalty '..feud(id.TAKEDA,id.HOJO)) end; if feud(id.HOJO,id.TAKEDA)~=-10 then error('Hojo->Takeda feud penalty '..feud(id.HOJO,id.TAKEDA)) end; LuaEvents.DiplomacyRibbon_OpenDiplomacyActionView(id.TAKEDA); return 'opened diplomacy with Takeda'

if ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('diplomacy hidden') end; local want=Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_1534_FEUD'); local stack; local function find(x,d) if d>40 or stack then return end; if x:GetID()=='RelationshipReasonStack' then stack=x; return end; for _,c in ipairs(x:GetChildren() or {}) do find(c,d+1) end end; for _,root in ipairs({Controls.OverviewContainer,ContextPtr}) do if not stack then pcall(find,root,0) end end; if not stack then error('RelationshipReasonStack not found under the diplomacy view') end; local function lab(x,id,d) if d>10 then return nil end; if x:GetID()==id then return x:GetText() end; for _,c in ipairs(x:GetChildren() or {}) do local r=lab(c,id,d+1); if r then return r end end end; local shown={}; local hit=false; for _,row in ipairs(stack:GetChildren() or {}) do local sc,tx=lab(row,'Score',0),lab(row,'Text',0); shown[#shown+1]=tostring(sc)..' '..tostring(tx); if tx and sc and string.find(tx,want,1,true) and string.find(sc,'-10',1,true) then hit=true end end; local line=table.concat(shown,' | '); print('[JAC_DIPLO] relationship reasons: '..line); if not hit then error('no -10 row with text '..want..'; displayed: '..line) end; return line
